_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 3 (B26, D4/§5) — layers a Blank Rune (the mod's uninscribed base rune) onto the Magitech Workshop's chest. Inert without Iron's Spells: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: a blank rune is a crafting intermediate that does nothing until inscribed with a gated Upgrade Orb — never a finished/inscribed rune or an Upgrade Orb itself.
